name: Kinjou Mizuki
source:
"Fufufu, What are you saying? It's OK, I'm always... al~ways going to be by your side, right?"

The devilish angel of Venus.
The Venus Prince.

The devilish prince of Venus who loves seeing the faces of people in shock, and often plays pranks on others.
When his pranks don't go well he always pouts and puffs out his cheeks.
He especially plays pranks on those he lets his guard down around, but he always acts kind afterwords and goes almost overboard when repenting.
He's always together with his friend [url=/c47599]Catherine[/url].
